description: Committee recommends applying for $1.1 million federal tree planting funds.
Project would plant 930 trees and diversify species.
Aims to increase city canopy cover to 15-20% by 2060.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
6 for, 0 against
Councillor Ford asked about financial impact if federal funding application is not approved.
Taxpayers will incur $61,000 annual operating costs for trees starting 2028.
Diversifying trees reduces risk from Dutch Elm disease and Cotton Ash Psyllid.
Staff confirmed the project would not have a mill rate impact.

description: Saskatoon's community emissions decreased 12% since 2014, missing 2023 target.
Corporate emissions decreased 7%; city saved $900,000 annually from LED streetlights.

chips.text: Staff noted landfill emissions are a legacy issue, difficult to reduce quickly.
Homeowners benefit from energy efficiency retrofits through a loan program.
Overall financial savings from climate initiatives are not yet comprehensively tracked.
Food forest pilots target neighborhoods experiencing high levels of food insecurity.
Landfill gas collection system reduces corporate emissions by 60,000 tons CO2E annually.
Zero emission vehicle plan for city fleet coming early next year.
